content:
Hi all,
Congrats on completing the project once again!
I know a lot of work has been done so far in upstreaming, and was wondering if there was any work that I could assist with? Cheers :)

Great to see someone interested in upstreaming! You could start with fixing the CI errors in pfr#266. Once that's done, you will be able to upstream the entropic Ruzsa calculus to add-combi. How does that sound?
